status: SPECIFICATION ONLY - no models are trained or deployed in this milestone

conditionally_allowed_feature_roles.reference_observation: Only in tasks whose 'reference_access' is not 'none', and only causally (values at or before the prediction time, at the documented availability schedule).

column_role_policy.notes: Protocol columns (operating_condition_id, setpoint_index, protocol_phase) are excluded as features because in simulation the planned set-point equals the true value. dq_flags (role quality_flag) is derived from observable fields only and may be used as a feature or as a pre-filter.

rules: No experiment_id may contribute rows to more than one partition.
Scalers, encoders, thresholds and feature statistics are fitted on the calibration partition only.
Hyper-parameters are chosen on the validation partition only.
The test partition is evaluated once per frozen model; results on it must not feed back into model or feature choices.
Within-run random splitting is forbidden (adjacent samples are correlated through dwell, lag and thermal state).
All window features are causal: they use only samples with elapsed_ms <= the prediction time.

candidate_models: gradient-boosted trees (shallow, monotone constraint on voltage_V)
metrics: empirical coverage of stated prediction interval vs true value

derived_features.name: ewm_current_squared_tau45
derived_features.definition: causal exponentially weighted mean of current_mA^2 with time constant 45 s

derived_features.name: ewm_current_squared_tau180
derived_features.definition: causal exponentially weighted mean of current_mA^2 with time constant 180 s

derived_features.name: seconds_since_last_level_change
derived_features.definition: causal time since |delta current_mA| last exceeded 50 mA

tasks.model_scope: one model per device_id; ambient held-out test condition reported separately
candidate_models: small first-order thermal grey-box model (physics-informed) fitted on calibration runs
metrics: error during first 3 thermal time constants after a load step

tasks.unit_of_prediction: record at time t, forecasting the drift component at t + horizon (horizons 0 s, 300 s, 600 s)
tasks.reference_schedule: one reference comparison every 300 s; the feature value is the most recent (temperature_C - reference_temperature_C) at or before t

derived_features.name: last_checkpoint_error
derived_features.definition: temperature_C - reference_temperature_C at the most recent 300 s checkpoint <= t

derived_features.name: checkpoint_error_slope
derived_features.definition: least-squares slope of past checkpoint errors (<= t)

tasks.oracle_note: true_drift_component is a simulation-only target. In a physical deployment the target would be the reference-based error at a later checkpoint; drift is not separable from a true process change without a reference.
baselines: analyze_temporal_drift linear slope extrapolation on checkpoint errors
candidate_models: Kalman filter / local linear trend state-space model
metrics: MAE and RMSE of predicted drift component per horizon

tracks.C1b_with_reference: reference_* allowed causally (same-record value) - reported separately

derived_features.name: causal_rolling_median_dev
derived_features.definition: |value - rolling median of previous 31 samples| / rolling MAD

derived_features.name: run_length_identical
derived_features.definition: number of consecutive identical readings ending at k

candidate_models: gradient-boosted trees on causal window features
isolation forest trained on fault-free calibration runs
temporal convolutional network (only if validation shows benefit over trees)
metrics: false alarms per hour on FD_*_NONE runs

target.name: drift_onset
target.definition: onset_elapsed_ms of the gradual_drift event (metadata fault_events); runs without such an event are negatives

derived_features.name: last_checkpoint_error
derived_features.definition: observed - reference at the most recent 300 s checkpoint <= t

candidate_models: Page-Hinkley / tuned CUSUM on checkpoint errors

target.name: fault_class
target.definition: label_fault_type ('none' or fault class; multi-label when ';'-joined)

baselines: rule mapping of DataQualityAssessor flags to classes (DUPLICATE_SEQ->duplicate_sequence, SEQ_GAP->communication_gap, STATUS->invalid_status, MISSING->missing_samples, NON_FINITE->non_finite, OUTLIER/ABRUPT_CHANGE->isolated_spike)
candidate_models: hierarchical classifier: observable-record faults by rules, signal faults by learned model
metrics: explicit report on the ambiguous classes (offset_shift, gain_change, gradual_drift, abrupt_change)

reproducibility: Record dataset suite manifest SHA-256 of every CSV used.
Fix and record all model random seeds; report mean and spread over at least 5 seeds.
Record library versions (numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn if used).
Store feature definitions as code under version control; no manual feature edits.
Report the conventional baseline from scripts/run_synthetic_benchmark.py alongside every ML result.
